units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:20">Y. Snh. X, 29ᵃ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 6:13">II Sam. VI, 13</cite>) <he>על כל צ׳ וצ׳ וכ׳</he> at every step they offered &c.; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite>.

Gen. R. s. 98 (play on בנות צעדה, Gen. XLIX, 22) [read:] שאני נותן לבנותיך צ׳ בתורה I will give thy daughters a step (or space) in the Law; מה צ׳ פרשה what is meant by tsʾidah? A section (Num. XXVII, 1-11).
